Features `default` (`all-bindings`), `bindgen`, `fips`, `ssl`, `asan`, and `disable-prebuilt-nasm` are inactive. `aws-lc-rs/build.rs` performs no subprocess execution, file writes, or network I/O; it checks feature mutual exclusion, reads `AWS_LC_RS_DISABLE_SLOW_TESTS` and `AWS_LC_RS_DEV_TESTS_ONLY` (plus `PROFILE` if dev-tests are enabled), selects `aws-lc-sys`, and re-exports `DEP_AWS_LC_<ver>_*` env vars as `cargo:*` metadata. In `aws-lc-sys/Cargo.toml`, optional build-dependency `bindgen 0.72.0` (gated by `bindgen`, `fips`, or `ssl`) is disabled, while `cc 1.2.26` (`features = ["parallel"]`), `cmake 0.1.54`, `dunce 1.0.5`, `fs_extra 1.3.0`, and unix-gated `pkg-config 0.3.31` (`[target."cfg(unix)".build-dependencies]`) are unconditionally compiled into the build script.

`sys_bindgen.rs` compile-time exclusion vs. conditional source effects (`PRIMARY-SOURCE-INDEX.md` L51/L57, `public-code/aws-lc-sys-0.45.0/builder/sys_bindgen.rs` L82-L149): `builder/main.rs` gates module `sys_bindgen` with `#[cfg(any(feature = "bindgen", feature = "fips"))]`. Because neither `bindgen` nor `fips` is active in the observed tree (`aws-lc-sys 0.45.0` features = `["prebuilt-nasm"]`), `sys_bindgen.rs` is compiled out and unreachable. If `bindgen` or `fips` were enabled, `generate_bindings` sets `TARGET` via `EnvGuard` and invokes `bindgen::Builder::generate()` on `<rust_include_path>/rust_wrapper.h` with `crate::prepare_clang_args(...)` and `.formatter(bindgen::Formatter::Rustfmt)` (L99), which would require `libclang`/`clang` and attempt to spawn `rustfmt`. None of these paths is active in the observed configuration.

`system_detect.rs` and `system_library.rs` search, `pkg-config` subprocess, and pre-generated bindings effects (`public-code/aws-lc-sys-0.45.0/builder/system_detect.rs` L41-L191, `public-code/aws-lc-sys-0.45.0/builder/system_library.rs` L46-L424, L436-L819): System AWS-LC linking can be entered either explicitly via `<CRATE>_SYSTEM_DIR` (`SystemLib::new`, fatal on error) or via best-effort auto-detection (`detect_system_awslc`, non-fatal fallback to source build unless `<CRATE>_USE_SYSTEM=1`). Under a strict clean environment on `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu` with `OPENSSL_DIR`, `OPENSSL_INCLUDE_DIR`, and `OPENSSL_LIB_DIR` unset, `detect_candidate_layouts()` (L89-L91) falls through to `#[cfg(unix)] fn pkg_config_candidates()` (L109-L130), which calls `pkg_config::Config::new().cargo_metadata(false).probe(module)` across `["openssl", "aws-lc", "libcrypto", "libcrypto-awslc"]`. This spawns up to four `pkg-config` subprocesses (if `pkg-config` exists in `PATH`) and emits `cargo:rerun-if-env-changed` for `PKG_CONFIG_*` variables. Any candidate discovered via env vars or `pkg-config` must pass `SystemLib::probe()` (`check_dependencies` + `validate`): (1) locate `libcrypto.{a,so}` or `libcrypto-awslc.{a,so}` in `<prefix>/lib64` or `<prefix>/lib` (or `pkg-config` link paths), (2) read `<include_dir>/openssl/base.h` and verify `#define OPENSSL_IS_AWSLC` (which deterministically rejects stock system OpenSSL/BoringSSL) plus `AWSLC_VERSION_NUMBER_STRING >= 1.68.0` (unless `*_SYSTEM_SKIP_VERSION_CHECK=1`), and (3) locate pre-generated Rust bindings on disk at `*_SYSTEM_BINDINGS` or `<prefix>/share/rust/aws_lc_bindings.rs` (`resolve_bindings`, L782-L819; `SystemLib` never runs `bindgen`). Only if all checks pass does `SystemLib::link()` copy `aws_lc_bindings.rs` to `<OUT_DIR>/bindings.rs`, emit `cargo:rustc-cfg=use_bindgen_pregenerated`, and emit native link directives.

`fips_probe.rs` compile-and-execute subprocess path is gated off (`public-code/aws-lc-sys-0.45.0/builder/system_library.rs` L279-L294, L311-L321, L364-L381, `public-code/aws-lc-sys-0.45.0/builder/fips_probe.rs` L92-L243): `SystemLib::validate()` calls `verify_fips_install` and `SystemLib::link()` calls `link_fips_runtime_check` only when `is_fips_build()` is true. When active, `verify_fips_install` invokes the C compiler returned by `cc::Build::new().get_compiler()` via `execute_command` to compile and link `builder/fips_link_probe.c` into `<OUT_DIR>/aws_lc_fips_link_probe` (with `-Wl,-rpath,<lib_dir>` and `-pthread -ldl -lm` for static Linux builds) and then executes that compiled binary on the host (or via `CARGO_TARGET_<TRIPLE>_RUNNER`) before deleting it. Under the observed non-FIPS feature set (`aws-lc-sys 0.45.0` = `["prebuilt-nasm"]`), this host binary execution path is inactive unless `is_fips_build()` is forced by `main.rs`.

`cmake_builder.rs` and `nasm_builder.rs` subprocess, tool-probe, and platform-branch effects (`public-code/aws-lc-sys-0.45.0/builder/cmake_builder.rs` L60-L80, L105-L334, L349-L760, `public-code/aws-lc-sys-0.45.0/builder/nasm_builder.rs` L52-L141): If `main.rs` selects `CmakeBuilder`: (1) `check_dependencies()` (L683-L724) unconditionally calls `find_cmake_command()` (L65-L80), which spawns `<CMAKE> --version` (if `CMAKE` env var is set) or probes `cmake3 --version` then `cmake --version`, setting `CMAKE` in process env or halting the build if neither executes successfully.
